errors.title: Cannot read the save
errors.NOT_A_GVAS_SAVE: This is not an Unreal/GVAS save — pick a real F1 Manager .sav file.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SAVE_FORMAT: Unsupported save version. F1 Manager 23 and 24 (volta23/volta24 builds) are supported.
errors.MALFORMED_GVAS: The save looks truncated or corrupted. Re-export from the game or try another copy.
errors.NOT_A_SQLITE_DB: The embedded database is invalid — the save may have been written incompletely.
errors.DB_INFLATE_FAILED: Could not inflate the database inside the save — the file may be damaged.
errors.MISSING_CORE_TABLES: Save is missing required tables: {tables}. This may be an unsupported mode/stage.
errors.DB_OPEN_FAILED: Could not open the SQLite database. Try again, or report the game build.
errors.NORMALIZE_FAILED: Parsed data could not be normalized — unknown schema. Report with the game build.
errors.WORKER_ERROR: System error while parsing (worker). Reload the page and try again.
errors.FILE_READ_ERROR: Could not read the file from disk. Try selecting it again.

awards.title: Weekend Awards
awards.dotdUnavailable: Driver of the Day is not stored in F1M 24 saves (no matching table) — not estimated.

dominant: The car was just incredible all weekend — we did everything right when it mattered.
Lights to flag, no real dramas out there. That's how you want a Sunday to go.
We had the pace to control it from the front, and the team gave me a perfect car for it.
close: That was closer than I'd have liked, honestly — but a win's a win, and I'll take it.
We had to fight for every tenth today. Great effort from everyone on the pit wall.
I could see them in my mirrors the whole way — nerve-wracking, but we held on.
balanced: Really pleased with how we managed that one. The team gave me a great strategy to work with.
That's exactly the kind of Sunday we needed. Thanks to everyone in the garage for the effort.
We knew after qualifying we had the pace — you still have to bring it home, and today we did.

dnf: Not the day we wanted. We'll go through the data and come back stronger next round.
Frustrating way to end the afternoon, but that's racing sometimes. Onto the next one.
The pace was there before it ended, which is the only positive I can take from today.
points: Solid day for the team — we maximised what we had and the points matter.
Happy to bring some points home. The car felt good once we got the balance sorted.
A good, clean race from our side. Small steps, but we're moving in the right direction.
midfield: Not the result we were hoping for, but there were some positives in the pace.
We were just on the wrong side of the fight for points today. It happens.
A tough midfield battle out there — everyone was so close on pace this weekend.
backmarker: Difficult weekend for us, but we'll keep working to understand where the pace went.
Not much more to say — we simply didn't have the pace to fight today.
We'll regroup and look at what we can improve before the next round.

transfers.title: Driver Market
transfers.empty: No future contracts (ContractType = 3) in the save at this point.

promotion: This is what I've been working towards my whole career — I can't wait to get in the car for {team}.
A dream come true, honestly. Time to prove I belong on the grid.
I'm not going to pretend I'm not nervous, but mostly I'm just excited to finally get my shot.
stepUp: This is a huge opportunity and I'm ready to grab it with both hands.
I've always believed I could compete for wins with the right car underneath me — now I get the chance to prove it.
Leaving {oldTeam} wasn't an easy decision, but this move is about fighting for more.
joiningUs: I've heard great things about this team's project, and I want to be part of building it further.
The ambition here matches mine — I think we can achieve something special together.
New chapter, new challenge. I can't wait to get started.
lateral: Sometimes a change of scenery is exactly what a career needs. I'm looking forward to the next chapter.
New team, new goals — I think this is the right move for where I am right now.
I want to thank everyone at {oldTeam} for the years together. Now it's time for something new.
